subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): narrow wildcard barrels to explicit used exports

question: May the observed 77-package corpus redefine the shipped plugin SDK contract immediately, or must all previously public non-deprecated symbols receive a deprecation window?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades ecosystem compatibility for a much smaller API surface; tests cannot determine whether maintainers accept breakage for private and unindexed plugins.

options.title: Add a compatibility window
options.body: Retain omitted shipped symbols as explicit deprecated re-exports with removal dates, then delete them after the announced window.

options.title: Approve immediate contraction
options.body: Explicitly accept that unobserved external plugins may fail on upgrade and document this as an intentional SDK-breaking release change.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Land only internal namespace-import cleanup and explicit lists that preserve the complete shipped export set.

recommendation.title: Add a compatibility window
recommendation.body: Retain omitted shipped symbols as explicit deprecated re-exports with removal dates, then delete them after the announced window.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged contract-reduction work and current series provide the clearest evidence of ownership over this API-policy choice.
